from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class CaseIdentifier(BaseModel):
    """Identifies the case by its number, court, and procedural level."""
    number: Optional[str] = Field(description="The case number string, e.g. '（2023）辽 0323 民初 4672 号'")
    court_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="The court associated with the case number")
    level: Optional[str] = Field(description="Procedural level: '一审', '二审', '再审', etc.")

class Party(BaseModel):
    """Identifies a party involved in the dispute."""
    name: Optional[str] = Field(description="The party's name, e.g. '李某某'")
    role: Optional[str] = Field(description="Role in this proceeding, e.g. '上诉人', '被上诉人'")

class Fee(BaseModel):
    """Captures court fee information and who bears it."""
    amount: Optional[str] = Field(description="The fee amount, e.g. '2031 元', '10584.14 元'")
    bearer: Optional[str] = Field(description="Who bears the fee, e.g. '李某某', '双方各半'")
    fee_type: Optional[str] = Field(description="Type of fee, e.g. '案件受理费', '保全费'")
    level: Optional[str] = Field(description="Fee level, e.g. '一审', '二审'")
    refund_info: Optional[str] = Field(description="Refund details if mentioned, e.g. '予以退还'")

class Court(BaseModel):
    """Records court names mentioned in the document."""
    name: Optional[str] = Field(description="The full name of the court")
    level: Optional[str] = Field(description="Level of court, e.g. 'High', 'Intermediate'")

class OutcomeStatement(BaseModel):
    """Captures the judicial disposition and outcome."""
    text: Optional[str] = Field(description="Verbatim summary of the outcome")
    actions: List[str] = Field(description="Specific orders or actions, e.g. ['撤销原判', '维持原判']")
    is_final: bool = Field(description="Whether the document explicitly states it is a final judgment/ruling")

class MonetaryOrder(BaseModel):
    """Captures specific monetary payment orders."""
    amount: Optional[str] = Field(description="The monetary amount ordered")
    payer: Optional[str] = Field(description="Who must pay")
    payee: Optional[str] = Field(description="Who receives the payment")
    description: Optional[str] = Field(description="What the payment is for, e.g. '补偿款', '赔偿款'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all extracted entities from a single judgment document."""
    case_identifiers: List[CaseIdentifier] = Field(description="Case numbers found in the document")
    parties: List[Party] = Field(description="Parties and their roles")
    fees: List[Fee] = Field(description="Court fee details")
    courts: List[Court] = Field(description="Courts mentioned")
    outcome_statements: List[OutcomeStatement] = Field(description="Judicial dispositions")
    monetary_orders: List[MonetaryOrder] = Field(description="Specific payment orders")
